*CRITICAL — merge blocker*

• *`src/dedupe.js:2` — Dedupes by object identity, not contact ID.* `new Set(contacts)` keeps separate objects with the same `id`, so overlapping imports remain duplicated through `mergeImports` (`src/merge.js:4`). This violates the first-seen-per-ID contract in `README.md:5`.
  *Fix:* Track seen IDs and retain only the first contact for each ID.

Verified with two distinct objects sharing `id: 1`: both `dedupe` and `mergeImports` return two contacts instead of the first alone. Add regression tests for that case, including overlap across lists; `test/dedupe.test.js` currently tests only a repeated object reference and distinct IDs.

*Validation:* All 4 existing tests pass. No other findings. No files changed.
